source_text.body:
Answer team questions through a Slack/Discord bot, CLI and MCP server
Bluesky's 50-person org uses diderot via Slack/Discord bot, CLI and MCP server for thousands of queries monthly; the post doesn't state what it queries.
·
Nov 21, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The post says diderot is exposed in several ways: a Slack/Discord bot for people, plus a CLI and an MCP server so agents can call it. It doesn't describe what diderot queries, how it was built, or how it runs internally. Austin posted it as a short note.
How it went
Bluesky, a 50-person org, runs thousands of diderot queries a month. Austin says technical and non-technical colleagues told him they can't imagine working without it. The post gives no accuracy or time-saved figures.
Try it yourself
with
Lindy
Copy prompt
Build me an assistant connected to our Slack/Discord that can answer team questions about [topic, e.g. our internal docs, codebase, or processes] by pulling from [data sources]. Make it available as a bot, a CLI command, and an MCP server so anyone on the team can query it, and test it with a handful of real questions before rolling it out to everyone.
Original source: https://bsky.app/profile/thebadcode.com/post/3n2rsftqrqs2w
